name: notification-settings
note: Scene state is a pure function of t, so these timings are exact. Salience follows the ADP-list rule: a change matters when it changes what you can do next.

events.what: focus ring moves onto the 'Enable notifications' row
events.reason: highlight movement is decoration; nothing new is possible
state change — the setting is now on

events.what: 'Notification sound' dropdown changes from disabled to enabled
events.reason: a control that could not be used now can be

events.what: tooltip appears over the sound info icon
tooltip disappears, focus ring moves to the sound dropdown

events.reason: scrolling reveals existing content; nothing changed state

events.what: 'Save changes' button changes from disabled to enabled
events.reason: a new action is now available

events.what: a confirmation dialog opens over a blocking overlay
events.reason: modal — nothing else will respond until it is dealt with

events.what: the dialog closes and a 'Settings saved' status appears
